audited_source_corrections.action: Made A false at the countermodel world while all premises remain true.
audited_source_corrections.source_issue_or_choice: The opening contrapositive calls M,w a countermodel but prints A as true there, which would satisfy rather than refute the target entailment.
audited_source_corrections.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் முன்கூற்றுகள் மெய்யாகவும் முடிவு A பொய்யாகவும் இருக்கும் வழக்கமான எதிர்மாதிரியைப் பயன்படுத்துகிறது.
audited_source_corrections.alternatives_considered: Negating one of the premises instead, which would not refute entailment.
audited_source_corrections.rationale: A countermodel to B_1,...,B_n entails A must satisfy every B_i and falsify A at the same world.
audited_source_corrections.precise_review_question: Is A false in the countermodel used for the contrapositive?

audited_source_corrections.action: Restored sigma on the true-falsity signed formula in the closure proof.
audited_source_corrections.source_issue_or_choice: The proposition and satisfaction premise are indexed by sigma, but its first proof sentence drops the prefix from the signed formula.
audited_source_corrections.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் மூடல் கூற்றிலுள்ள அதே முன்னொட்டு sigma வை நிறுவலிலும் வைத்துள்ளது.
audited_source_corrections.alternatives_considered: Treating the unprefixed signed formula as a separate tableau language.
audited_source_corrections.rationale: This chapter defines satisfiability only for prefixed signed formulas.
audited_source_corrections.precise_review_question: Does true falsity carry sigma in both statement and proof?

audited_source_corrections.action: Applied f to the accessible extended prefix and evaluated A at that extended world.
audited_source_corrections.source_issue_or_choice: The proof's accessibility expression omits f on sigma-star, and the monotonicity conclusion repeats the starting world instead of the accessible world; the preceding sentence is also grammatically interrupted.
audited_source_corrections.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் பொருள்கோள் f ஐ இரு முன்னொட்டுகளுக்கும் பயன்படுத்தி, நீட்டித்த முன்னொட்டின் உலகில் A மெய் என்று முடிக்கிறது.
audited_source_corrections.alternatives_considered: Keeping the repeated starting-world conclusion, which cannot contradict falsity at the extension.
audited_source_corrections.rationale: Persistence transports truth from f(sigma) to f(sigma-star), exactly the world where the false signed formula is interpreted.
audited_source_corrections.precise_review_question: Does monotonicity carry A to f(sigma-star)?

audited_source_corrections.action: Restored sigma on the false-disjunction premise.
audited_source_corrections.source_issue_or_choice: Every surrounding rule case and the rule table use a prefix, but the false-disjunction exercise case omits it.
audited_source_corrections.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் முன்னுரை வாய்பாட்டில் sigma முன்னொட்டை மீட்டமைக்கிறது.
audited_source_corrections.alternatives_considered: Leaving the rule application without a world name in a prefixed tableau system.
audited_source_corrections.rationale: The semantic branch interpretation requires a prefix for every signed formula.
audited_source_corrections.precise_review_question: Is the false disjunction indexed by sigma?

audited_source_corrections.action: Used the two actual rule conclusions, true B and false C at sigma.n, in both extended-branch sets.
audited_source_corrections.source_issue_or_choice: The paragraph correctly names the false-conditional rule's two conclusions and constructs a witness for them, but both set expressions instead add a false copy of the conditional at the new prefix.
audited_source_corrections.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் இரு கண வெளிப்பாடுகளிலும் புதிய முன்னொட்டில் மெய்-B மற்றும் பொய்-C ஆகியவற்றைச் சேர்க்கிறது.
audited_source_corrections.alternatives_considered: Changing the witness construction to satisfy a false conditional at the successor, which is neither the rule conclusion nor supported by the chosen world.
audited_source_corrections.rationale: The selected accessible witness makes B true and C false, exactly satisfying the two signed formulas generated by the rule.
audited_source_corrections.precise_review_question: Do both extended-branch sets contain true B and false C at sigma.n?

audited_source_corrections.action: Concluded Gamma entails A after the countermodel contradiction.
audited_source_corrections.source_issue_or_choice: The corollary assumes Gamma proves A and aims to establish entailment, but its last line repeats the already assumed derivability claim.
audited_source_corrections.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் முரணுக்குப் பின் துணைமுடிவின் இலக்கான பின்விளைவை முடிவாகக் கூறுகிறது.
audited_source_corrections.alternatives_considered: Repeating derivability, which leaves the corollary unproved.
audited_source_corrections.rationale: Eliminating the supposed countermodel proves Gamma entails A.
audited_source_corrections.precise_review_question: Does the final line state entailment rather than repeat derivability?
